purpose: Bounded factorial mechanism experiment for the HCL memory interface after the completed v5 negative result; no baseline/tool tuning or efficacy claim from qualification.
source_state: Frozen v5 H_A: two A-training raw records and one generated main_policy; copied exactly before interface transformations. No new memories or model abstractions generated.
hypotheses: Global lexical top2 can starve abstract guidance; one raw plus one abstract guarantees exposure without adding a third memory slot.

Historical bare option letters may encourage answer-label confusion; representing the same historical feedback as its own option text may reduce this without changing current options or official scoring. The single v5 letter flip does not prove this cause.

selection.A: Single image and metadata diagnosis, outside B-eligible case groups
selection.B: Two to four images and metadata comparison
selection.exclusions: All148 prior development case groups including all88 v5 members, plus known shared canonical image paths and source URLs
selection.rule: Metadata-only seeded case grouping, one question per case, freeze members before associating labels; all24 are new development report cases with no selection/tuning role.

factorial.retrieval: Original global lexical top2 versus top1 raw plus top1 abstract. Both use original unmodified views for ranking and fixed memory-id tie breaks.
factorial.representation: Historical previous_attempt and correct_feedback remain original letters versus exact option text parsed from that record's original training question. Transformation occurs AFTER selection, so letter/semantic arms select identical IDs in identical order.
factorial.unchanged: All memory source records, images, current question/options, author system/question prompts, six native tools/defaults, two-turn workflow and exact final A-F scoring.
factorial.context_limit: Always two memory slots for learned arms. Content length necessarily differs; measure and disclose rather than claiming token-matched contexts.
factorial.baseline: H0 has no added memory context and is not optimized.

execution.case_order: Alternate A/B cases in frozen seeded order; rotate all five arm orders by case index
execution.state: Fresh agent and MemorySaver per case/arm; memory immutable; no report feedback enters controller
execution.scoring: Read report gold only after all predictions are complete or the run has irreversibly stopped. All120 planned episodes remain denominator, failed/not-run wrong.
execution.initial_letter: Secondary consistency measure: parse only an explicit A-F at the start of the first final message after leading whitespace/asterisks; record parseable denominator. Never replace official second-turn scoring.

analysis.primary: Exact final accuracy and paired gains/losses for all arms, split A/B and pooled24
secondary: initial-to-final option changes with parseable denominator
analysis.combined_development_signal: All120 complete/valid; balanced_semantic improves at least2/24 over global_letter with zero losses of global_letter-correct cases, and has no net A or B decline versus H0. This is a small development signal only, not evidence of new-task acquisition or retention.
analysis.statistics: Paired four cells and descriptive two-sided exact McNemar for all declared contrasts; no significance-based winner selection, no corrected clinical claim.
analysis.decision: Report every cell. Do not adopt from a single favorable subgroup or change scoring. Any adoption/continual-learning follow-up needs a new frozen protocol and new report groups; a null result closes this exact interface family rather than prompting unrestricted searches.

storage: Reuse v4 models and v5 runtime/HCL source read-only; count v4+v5+v6 aggregate under45GB stop and strict50GB. No new model downloads.
public_boundary: Source/protocol/aggregate only; no raw questions, images, answers, case IDs, memory contents, credentials or per-case predictions.
